n-programmable-rules.title: Launchpad coins with on-chain rules
n-programmable-rules.summary: Coins from launchpads whose tokens carry rules enforced on-chain. Hooked (HOOKED, on Meteora's dynamic bonding curve) says rules are built into the token with Token-2022 transfer hooks, and the @MeteoraEco account described it on 2026-10-04 as letting builders choose who can hold, how tokens trade and who gets rewarded. SPEC (spec.fun's own page: Solana programmable extension coins, 73 extensions) and HOOKI (@Hoookedpad's 2026-10-05 post: an AI agent that rewrites a token's rules on Hooked) are on Solana; pickhooks (hooks, on Flap) describes itself in its metadata as a launchpad on BNB Chain where coins carry rules, and its own account announced version 2 on 2026-10-04. These are project descriptions; whether the rules work as described, and any affiliation among the four coins beyond the Hooked-HOOKI link, is not verified, and one public review notes hooks are not permanent by default. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

n-programmable-rules.interpretation: Several launchpads now sell tokens whose rules are enforced on-chain (Solana transfer hooks on Hooked and SPEC, contract rules on pickhooks), and public posts call it a new launchpad meta. The rules, traction figures and any link between the coins are project claims and are not verified; one public post is skeptical of the Hooked ecosystem, and one review notes hooks are not permanent by default.

summaries.n-holder-rewards: Coins whose metadata says holders earn another asset: ZCAT (ZEC), PUMPE (PEPE reflections), MASKCAT (MASK, which pays ZEC), MMBTC (WBTC), SEC (XRP), STUPIDINU (paired with USELESS rewards) and USEFUL COIN (metadata: "Paired with $USELESS... a relationship that pays"). StonkFun's official account posted on 2026-09-29 that its upgraded rewards pipeline is live for legacy coins including ZCAT, and on 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03 that Community Mode lets new memecoins share holder rewards with holders of paired community coins. Payouts are claims from the coins and the platform and are not verified. Measured: seven coins across all their pools; the paired assets are not counted.

Finally, a relationship that pays.", the same paired-reward pitch as STUPIDINU, already a member. The paired reward is a claim from the coin; no payout is verified. Pool about 53 hours old; 24h price change about +14%; member bars checked (24h volume about $0.55M, market cap about $148K, no quarantine flag); exact chain, address and covered origin launchpad from the d1 sweep.

solana:C1mBfBoDkwWfd6uTFZp62ARHLjeVp3bDp.rationale: Hooked (HOOKED, MeteoraDBC): metadata says "Launch a token with rules built into the token itself. Solana runs the transfer hook on every trade." @MeteoraEco (2026-10-04) says Hooked is powered by Meteora's dynamic bonding curve and uses Token-2022 transfer hooks to let builders choose who can hold tokens, how they trade and who gets rewarded; many third-party posts review it, some as call-group promotion, and one calls the ecosystem's holders poor. Rejected earlier as one coin with no second coin sharing the mechanism; SPEC, HOOKI and pickhooks now give it three. Pool about 176 hours old; member bars checked (24h volume about $3.6M, market cap about $7.0M, no quarantine flag); exact chain, address and covered origin launchpad from the d1 sweep.

solana:3ykvcjrzbb5nyJRnzHVEA12sQsZfnTijw.rationale: HOOKI (HOOKI, MeteoraDBC): its metadata is empty; the official @Hoookedpad account (2026-10-05) says "We gave an AI agent his own wallet and the keys to a token's rules", and third-party posts say HOOKI launched on Hooked. The e4 search that returned these posts was refunded as a negative result (most tweets lacked both search words) but the posts are retained; the 2026-10-05 @Hoookedpad post is the only source for the mechanism. The pool was about 11 hours old with a 24h price change of about +4,899% (just under the 50x quarantine ratio, market cap about $254K, 24h volume about 17.6x market cap), so its volume is flagged by the volume caveat. Member bars checked (24h volume about $4.5M, market cap above $100K, no quarantine flag); exact chain, address and covered origin launchpad from the d1 sweep.

solana:2AVjqmGbMqg7rSyHVv2deVdggsBgBtu1B.rationale: Spec (SPEC, MeteoraDBC): its metadata is empty; the official spec.fun page scraped on 2026-10-06 describes "Solana Programmable Extension Coins" where "Solana enforces every option on every transfer" (73 extensions) and lists $SPEC as its top token (24h volume about $0.6M, market cap about $240K, matching the Codex snapshot). A public post (2026-10-04) positions it against $Hooked. Rejected on 2026-10-04 for having no metadata and no source; the official page now supplies the mechanism. Pool about 59 hours old; 24h price change about -60%; member bars checked (24h volume about $0.61M, market cap about $246K, no quarantine flag); exact chain, address and covered origin launchpad from the d1 sweep.

bsc:0x07bcb8e8226f671300e135b4a61dc15735.rationale: pickhooks (hooks, Flap): metadata says "one token, one rule. a launchpad on BNB Chain where coins carry rules." Pool about 52 hours old; member bars checked (24h volume about $1.2M, market cap about $650K, no quarantine flag); exact chain, address and covered origin launchpad from the d1 sweep.

k-intelligence.reason: Shared word only. OpenAI (Clanker, 18 hours old, about $81M 24h volume at a market cap of about $1.36M) copies OpenAI's mission statement; Open AI (ChatGPT-6) and NVIDIA are namesake coins, and a search for the coin found only posts about the company itself, so no story or independent source ties these coins together. ANIMA is a separate Flap framework, 币安智能 and bibi are the Binance Intelligence lead (k-binance, deferred), and SLIME and DSI are under the $100K market cap bar.

k-creator.reason: Strongest new lead after the hooks story: Feebits (FEEBITS; metadata "Launch a coin for your favorite streamer. We turn its creator fees into Bits and send them automatically") has two coins (Meteora DBC about $23.4M 24h volume, Pump.fun about $3.9M) and official @feebitsdotfun and @pandez_ posts (2026-10-05 and 2026-10-06: "Feebits is now live", "150k bits paid out to streamers"), but both are the same product's coin; no third coin names the streamer mechanism (knightcat, AC, MENTOR and HARMONIC share only the word creator, MENTOR is under the market cap bar). Revisit when a coin launched through Feebits clears the bars.

k-stocks.reason: Still deferred. STONK (StonkFun platform coin), OTC (stocks and pre-IPO desks) and SLAZH (tokenized stocks as card packs) use stocks in different mechanisms, and BEYOND (tokenized equities access, 2 hours old) and GSTOCK add two more; the only independent post found (@floordottop, 2026-10-05, about OKX and ICE filing for round-the-clock US stock trading) is about the sector, not these coins.
